spells.name: Skitterleap
spells.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Warpgale
spells.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Wither
spells.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
